nodes.prompt:
TASK: Derive the smallest safe state model that makes every Git worktree own independent visible tab/session layout while preserving existing terminal pane splits, browser tabs, and project-level persistence in Ferryx. This is an executable read-only architecture assignment.
DELIVERABLE: A precise implementation contract: data model additions/changes, reducer/UI integration points, persistence schema migration strategy, and 3 deterministic RED tests. State whether selection should swap the active layout or derive a filtered view, and select exactly one approach with a causal justification.
SCOPE: Read only ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/state/layout.ts, ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/lib/types.ts, and their direct tests. Do not edit, commit, create files, or touch unrelated current changes.
VERIFY: Cite exact path:line facts and prove your selected approach handles terminal panes and BrowserTab.worktreePath.
STOP WHEN: You have returned one chosen state model, exact affected paths, and three RED test designs.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Recover Ferryx's intended worktree-to-tab behavior from local source and documented parity artifacts, then state the observable UX contract that a fix must meet. This is a read-only assignment.
DELIVERABLE: A concise evidence report with the intended behavior when switching worktrees, whether terminal/browser tabs must be worktree-owned, persistence/restart expectations, and source/doc citations. Explicitly distinguish documented requirements from inference.
SCOPE: Read only README.md, PRODUCT.md, BROWSER_SUPPORT_PLAN.md, ORCA_TAB_SPLIT_TERMINAL_RUNTIME_FIX_REPORT.md, FERRYX_PARITY_FULL_SWEEP.md, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/App.tsx, and ui/original-dist only if needed. Do not edit or run Git writes.
VERIFY: Provide exact path:line or section references for every claimed requirement.
STOP WHEN: You return the observable UX contract and any remaining ambiguity.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Independently choose a minimal, end-to-end implementation boundary for Ferryx worktree-scoped tab/session state and restart persistence, based on current code.
DELIVERABLE: A repair-ready verdict containing exact files to modify, the single persistence API shape to use, the exact RED test order, and regression commands.
SCOPE: Read only ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/state/layout.ts, ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/lib/types.ts, ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx, ui/src/App.test.tsx, src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs, and src-tauri/tests/session_persistence_integration.rs. Do not edit or commit.
VERIFY: Cite exact paths and select a design that makes worktree A's terminal and browser tabs invisible while worktree B is selected, then restores both sets across app restart.
STOP WHEN: You return one unambiguous implementation plan with RED tests.
